summary: Three snapshot-build units drift-skip locally/CI while prod Postgres carries stale or partial state. Bastrop edition currency is the highest-impact drift: BDC 2026 indexed in prod but not marked current; committed snapshot is B3-only.

units.label: Bastrop UDC (Path C / Municode)

liveProbe.buildLogErrorShape: ingest produced 0 sections — likely live-source drift

units.rootCause: Structural, not transient API failure. Municode Supplement 20 TOC (clientId 1169) has no 'Unified Development Code' product. Chapter 14 is 'BASTROP BUILDING BLOCK (B3) CODE' — three adoption-by-reference sections pointing to bastrop.gov, not full zoning text. chapterFilter regex matches nothing at walk time.

relevantHeadings: Chapter 10 - PARKLAND DEDICATION AND PARK ENRICHMENT FUND
municodeTocEvidence.missingHeading: Unified Development Code / Bastrop Development Code (BDC)

prodState.actualBastropCodeSource: Ord. 2026-06 PDF (bastrop-bdc-chapter14-ingest) + legacy B3 PDF unit

proposedFix.recommendation: HONEST_RETIREMENT of Path C Municode unit for bastrop_tx UDC. Replace with explicit BDC PDF unit in build-corpus-snapshot UNITS wired to ingest-bastrop-bdc-chapter14 post-step. Optional: ingest Municode Ch.14 adoption pointers as stub cross-refs only (3 sections), not as UDC corpus.
proposedFix.doNot: Do not tune chapterFilter expecting full BDC from Municode — source does not exist there.

units.label: ICC model codes (Layer 1)
units.skipMechanism: IccCodeConnectAdapter.mode === 'unconfigured' when ICC_CODE_CONNECT_CLIENT_ID and ICC_CODE_CONNECT_CLIENT_SECRET unset; runIccModelCodeIngest returns {editions:0, sections:0} without throwing

prodState.note: Prod ICC corpus from July 2026 bake with credentials present; NOT refreshed by 2026-08-05 snapshot rebuild.

units.impact: Local/CI snapshot builds silently drop ICC (~4.8k sections). Citations leg for building-code lookups depends on prod pg state, not committed snapshot. Re-bake without ICC env reproduces 0-section skip.

proposedFix.recommendation: Document ICC_CODE_CONNECT_* as required env for full snapshot builds (DEPLOY.md addendum). CI: either inject credentials from secret store or mark ICC unit as explicit skip-with-reason in build log (not drift-shaped 0-section). Re-run build-corpus-snapshot with credentials + eval before next pg-load.
proposedFix.alternative: Pin prod ICC from last good bake and exclude ICC unit from snapshot rebuild until credentials provisioned (honest hold).

units.label: Grand County (Path B / legacy Neon)
units.skipMechanism: Throws 'LEGACY_DATABASE_URL not set — Path B Grand County skipped' when LEGACY_DATABASE_URL and DATABASE_URL both unset; caught by runUnit as ok:false, 0 sections

prodState.stalenessNote: Grand County corpus not refreshed in snapshot rebuild since 2026-05-26 (~10 weeks stale in prod metadata vs 2026-08-05 snapshot bake)

units.impact: Local/CI snapshot builds cannot verify Grand County eval. Committed snapshot.json omits Moab public-free corpus. Prod still serves 285 atoms from prior pg-load.

proposedFix.recommendation: Either (A) provision LEGACY_DATABASE_URL in snapshot build env (factory runbook secret: legacy Neon read path) and re-migrate Path B on each bake, or (B) HONEST_RETIREMENT: export Grand County to committed JSON artifact like Smithville eCode360 file, remove live Neon dependency.
proposedFix.doNot: Do not silently accept 0-section skip as 'clean' in build logs without explicit env-missing reason code.
